origin.description: Orthogonal matrix that rotates B toward A, and the residual distance.

arguments.name: B
arguments.text: Matrix to rotate. Same size as A.

origin.details: Orthogonal alignment of two 2 by 3 matrices.
origin.value: Orthogonal matrix that rotates B toward A, and the residual distance.
origin.example: local({A<-matrix(1:6, 2, 3); B<-matrix(c(2, 1, 4, 3, 6, 5), 2, 3); with(procrustes(A, B), c(P, Q, d))})

translation.description: Orthogonal matrix that rotates B toward A, and the residual distance.

arguments.name: B
arguments.text: Matrix to rotate. Same size as A.

translation.details: Orthogonal alignment of two 2 by 3 matrices.
translation.value: Orthogonal matrix that rotates B toward A, and the residual distance.
translation.example: (lambda z: np.concatenate([np.ravel(z['P'], order='F'), np.ravel(z['Q'], order='F'), [z['d']]]))(procrustes(np.array([1,2,3,4,5,6], dtype=float).reshape((2, 3), order='F'), np.array([2,1,4,3,6,5], dtype=float).reshape((2, 3), order='F')))
